title: Chromogenic in situ detection of microRNAs in paraffin embedded tissue microarrays by locked nucleic acid probes
protocol: Dilute LNA DIG labelled probes according to published protocol and manufacturer's instructions.
Prepare hybridization mix by adding 5ml of ultra pure 50% formamide, 2.5ml of 20x SSC, 500 μl of 10 ug/μl yeast t-RNA, and 200 μl of 50x Denhardt’s solution to 1.8 ml DEPC-treated water.
Divide hybridization mix into aliquots and store at -20°C.
Adjust the pH of the hybridization buffer to 6-6.5.
If hybridization temperature exceeds 55°C, add citric acid to a final concentration of 9.2 mM.
Prepare proteinase K buffer with 100 mM Tris-HCl (pH 8) and 50 mM EDTA (pH 8).
Prepare AP buffer by mixing 100 mM Tris HCl (pH 9.5), 50 mM MgCl2, 100 mM NaCl, and 0.1% Tween 20.
Prepare DEPC-treated water by adding 1 ml of DEPC to 1L water, mixing well, leaving overnight in a fume hood, then autoclaving the solution.
Cut 5 µm paraffin sections from paraffin block and place them at 37°C incubator overnight for drying.
Treat the paraffin sections slides 3 times with xylene for 5 minutes each.
Immerse the slides in 100% ethanol 2 times for 5 minutes.
Immerse the slides in 70% ethanol for 5 minutes.
Immerse the slides in 50% ethanol for 5 minutes.
Immerse the slides in 25% ethanol for 5 minutes.
Wash the slides with DEPC water for 1 minute.
Wash the slides 2 times in PBS for 5 minutes each.
Treat the slides for 5 minutes with proteinase K (10 µg/ml) at room temperature.
Stop the proteinase K reaction by treating the slides for 30 seconds in 0.2% glycine in PBS.
Rinse the slides twice in PBS.
Wash the slides twice, each for 5 minutes in PBS.
Pre-hybridize the slides in hybridization buffer according to published protocol for 1 hour at the probes' hybridization temperature.
Mix 2.5 picomoles of diluted probe in 100-200 μl of hybridization buffer.
Pipette the hybridization mix onto the slide.
Place the slide in a humidified incubation box for 2 hours.
Rinse the slides in a water bath at the hybridization temperature for 5 minutes in 2XSSC.
Wash the slides three times, each for 30 minutes in a water bath with 50% formamide and 2XSSC at the hybridization temperature.
Wash the slides 5 times for 5 minutes in PBS at room temperature.
Block the slides at room temperature for 1 hour in blocking buffer.
Incubate the slides overnight with antibody at +4 °C.
Wash the slides for 3-4 times in PBST.
Wash the slides 3-4 times in AP buffer.
Cover the slides with BCIP/NBT liquid substrate in a humidified chamber until colour develops.
Stop the colour reaction by washing the slides with PBST for 15 minutes.
Dry the slides, do not over dry.
Mount the slides gently using aquamount mounting medium.
Image the slide using any suitable conventional microscope.
